bullets.bullet_text: Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing governance for regulated financial institutions, structuring traceable scenario architectures and model-risk remediation frameworks that anchored audit-grade regulatory delivery.

Led quantitative derivatives and variable-annuity hedging engagements for insurers, applying exotic pricing, liability Greek stress-testing, and capital adequacy modeling to support insurance-capital reference architecture.

Architected enterprise risk-governance operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics for portfolio-wide governance across business units.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
